findings.title: The Lordward return as an appointed encounter
findings.claim: The passive return to the Lord in 32:11 acquires the shape of a compelled encounter: the criminals seen after it ask to be sent back so they can act again, while 32:14 names the meeting they had neglected. The focus return and their requested reversal therefore remain distinct movements, and the promised destination is read as arrival at the encounter rather than a reopened earthly opportunity.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier is the passive, Lord-directed تُرْجَعُونَ at 32:11:11:1. The supplied 32:12 scene supplies a separate return request, attributed by HFT to word index 12, in which the criminals ask to be returned so they can do right; its bowed heads at index 5 embody recognition after the promised return. The next supplied context names لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ at 32:14, HFT word index 4, and pairs forgetting that meeting with being left at indices 3 and 8. These contacts make the focus return an imposed arrival at the meeting, while the requested return is an attempt to recover agency. The focus death-taking verb يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم also receives a qualified appointed-meeting resonance from the meeting named in 32:14.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can distinguish the return already promised to the addressees from the later return they plead for: one brings them to the Lord and the meeting they neglected; the other would give them another chance to act.
findings.containment: The recoverable before reading remains that return means coming back after death. The contextual change is the source's after reading: compelled arrival for encounter, followed by a request for an unavailable reverse journey. The source itself leaves open that the request may dramatize regret without fixing the mechanics of 32:11; that alternative remains live. The WFY meeting facet is a qualified root-family resonance: the focus form is Form V and its ordinary death-taking sense remains intact, so the meeting branch is not asserted as a standalone gloss of يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم. HFT word indices, context segmentation, and attributed roles remain source-attributed because the reader identity is legacy_unbound and context morphology is not supplied.

findings.title: Death as compelled yielding
findings.claim: The ordinary bodily death remains in place, while the following scene lets death also be heard as the point at which resistance yields: the criminals bow before the truth that has become due, and the promised return brings them to that recognition.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is الْمَوْتِ at 32:11:4:2, whose supplied focus branch says that a person yields to truth and releases resistance. The independent macro trigger is the context: the HFT trace locates the lowered heads at 32:12 word index 5 and the word حَقَّ at 32:13 word index 8, while the supplied Arabic shows the criminals bowed before their Lord and the decree made due. Contact with the passive return تُرْجَعُونَ at 32:11:11:1 changes death from only the end of bodily life before return into the moment at which resistance collapses and the person is delivered to acknowledged truth.
findings.reader_payoff: Death keeps its plain life-ending sense and also gains a concrete scene of surrender: the return is shown arriving with lowered heads and recognition of what can no longer be evaded.
findings.containment: The HFT before reading is that death ends bodily life before return; its after reading adds compelled collapse of resistance and recognition. The source itself requires bodily death to remain primary and treats yielding as an affective-legal overlay. The connection is attributed because the HFT source is legacy_unbound and the context's morphology is not supplied. The bowed posture may dramatize regret and acknowledgment without changing the mechanics of 32:11; that reading remains possible.

epistemic.reason: The focus has an exact accepted branch record for yielding to truth, and the supplied Arabic anchors 32:12 and 32:13 are complete. The association of context word indices, roots, branches, and roles is from a reconstructed legacy_unbound trace, so the result remains an attributed overlay with biological death intact.
